reason: The cookie value is derived from a cryptographically strong random number generator (SecureRandom) rather than user input. Even though the header is user-controlled, it is processed through multiple transformations (URL decoding, string manipulation, Base64 encoding) before becoming the cookie value, rendering it non-malicious.

evidence.note: The cookie value is generated using java.security.SecureRandom.nextGaussian(), ensuring cryptographic strength and preventing user-controlled payload injection.
